        have h14 : n % 25 ≤ 9 := by

        have h15 : n % 25 = 0 ∨ n % 25 = 1 ∨ n % 25 = 2 ∨ n % 25 = 3 ∨ n % 25 = 4 ∨ n % 25 = 5 ∨ n % 25 = 6 ∨ n % 25 = 7 ∨ n % 25 = 8 ∨ n % 25 = 9 := by
